simulation_assumptions.name: simulated-gimbal-imu-drive-feedback-v1
simulation_assumptions.filter: VQF 2.1.2 online VQF; uses only accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer
simulation_assumptions.acceleration_semantics: proper acceleration in sensor body frame, m/s^2; zero is valid free-fall data
simulation_assumptions.magnetometer_semantics: raw signed counts divided by 32768 for storage/VQF; no uT calibration evidence
simulation_assumptions.sensor_mount_assumption: IMU axes aligned with pitch_link; no mount rotation or bias calibration available
simulation_assumptions.gimbal_kinematics: R_body_sensor = Rz(yaw) * Ry(-pitch); pitch joint positive direction is local -Y
simulation_assumptions.attitude_source_simulation: VQF 2.1.2 estimated from noisy accel/gyro/magnetometer only
simulation_assumptions.attitude_source_hardware: ATK-IMU901 firmware quaternion is passed through; Euler remains diagnostic-only
simulation_assumptions.temperature_semantics: decoded for diagnostics only; excluded from the policy vector and VQF fusion
simulation_assumptions.motor_iq_semantics: simulation equivalent Iq only when supplied by the explicit actuator-effort model; assumed Kt=0.035 Nm/A and efficiency=1, uncalibrated and not measured current

feedback.missing_or_expired: group values are zero and its valid flag is zero; age is bounded

estimated_pose.position_source: simulated UWB position measurement from plant pose plus Gaussian noise
estimated_pose.sampling: one independent measurement per unique FieldTask.time using a dedicated episode-seeded RNG
estimated_pose.heading_source: feedback attitude with measured gimbal inverse kinematics; zero when invalid
estimated_pose.gimbal_source: feedback measured joint positions; zero when invalid

drive_config.integral_gain_status: uncalibrated simulation candidate; not real motor/controller calibration
drive_config.drivetrain_note: Torque and RPM are idealized proxy-equivalent values: one motor per side, unit efficiency, 60 mm active sprocket, and 45 mm proxy support rollers. The 2 Nm per-wheel effort cap is not a measured motor rating.

same_side_wheel_coupling.execution: retain per-wheel actuators, PI state and configured effort limits

damage_config.track_center_separation_status: 0.41 m center separation derived from user-confirmed 0.47 m overall width and 0.06 m track width; 0.30 m chassis width excludes tracks
damage_config.track_vertical_model: union of RobotAssetSpec wheel-cylinder vertical AABBs rotated by current pitch/roll; damage requires overlap with stem root_z +/- stem_radius
damage_config.chassis_geometry: RobotAssetSpec box footprint against main stem only
damage_config.vertical_model: 2.5D: current engine root Z with pitch/roll-expanded vertical AABB; horizontal footprint remains level; compare against stem root_z..root_z+height

latest_complete_checkpoint.checkpoint_selection_rule: highest numeric model_N.pt that was stable across pre-load polls, CPU-loadable with required RSL resume fields, and unchanged during load; candidate directory rescanned after load

resume_boundary.reason: Checkpoint contains the learned actor/critic parameters and Adam state, but not the live PhysX environment state, random-generator states, rollout buffer, or the in-flight LSTM hidden state. Resuming starts a new rollout from restored weights/optimizer and saved progress; it is a training resume, not bitwise exact continuation of the stopped live session.

snapshot_reproducibility_assessment.reason: The snapshot preserves the manifested project/trial sources and pyproject, but does not contain an Isaac Sim/Kit distribution, Isaac Lab/PhysX/RSL-RL source/runtime, or a complete dependency lock/environment. The protocol records expected versions and the launcher uses a machine-local C:/pioneer/isaac-training/.venv. Reproduction requires that external runtime, compatible GPU driver/hardware, installed packages, and the run's assets/configuration; the source_snapshot directory alone is insufficient.
runtime_dependencies_not_embedded_in_sou: CUDA-compatible GPU driver/runtime and GPU hardware
project assets and the configured local Isaac training environment

limitations: This is a CPU checkpoint/source-integrity audit, not a simulation, GUI, policy evaluation, training completion, or learning-performance acceptance.
The training process/run_status may advance after the recorded audit timestamp; the checkpoint selected here is the latest stable and loadable candidate observed by this script.
No live source hash comparison was made; the immutable source_snapshot hashes are the relevant frozen evidence.
